newsitem.title: USA: MGI Pharma trims Q1 loss as sales climb.
newsitem.headline: MGI Pharma trims Q1 loss as sales climb.

text.p: MGI Pharma Inc on Wednesday said a surge in product sales in the first helped the pharmaceutical maker narrow its losses from the same period of 1996.

MGI reported a loss of $535,803, or $0.04 a share, in the period, compared with a loss of $803,507, or $0.06, in the year-ago period. Total revenues rose to $2.9 million from $2.1 million in the corresponding period in 1996.
Net sales climbed to $2.2 million from $1.3 million, the company said.
MGI officials said its financial strength in the quarter bodes well for the rest of 1997, and the company may reach profitability sooner than expected if revenues continue to grow.
MGI shares were 7/16 higher at 4-1/8 late Wednesday afternoon.
